semiconductor_relevance: High — the company specializes in plasma and RF sensors critical for plasma processing in semiconductor fabrication.
summary: PPT Co., Ltd. is a leading provider of direct plasma and RF sensors designed to enhance understanding and control of plasma processes in semiconductor manufacturing. Their products are aimed at improving yield and throughput while minimizing maintenance and downtime in fabrication environments.
capabilities: Direct plasma sensors for R&D and process control
RF sensors for plasma processing equipment
Plasma control applications for feedback mechanisms
